The '''Mini-Forge''' is a portable version of the [[Forge]] found on Floor 10 in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Combat Mastery]].

It acts exactly the same as the regular forge and can be placed anywhere.
